pages.title: Giving gear a voice
text: Any Spiritgear tool or Spiritweave piece can answer one totem voice. Place a Resonance Totem, carry a charged Pulse Cell, and crouch-use the piece on the totem.
Binding spends **40 Pulse**. The totem is not used up, the action bar names the voice, and you can overwrite it any time the same way. Empty-handed clicks still read the totem as usual.
Mixed sets are intended: a Fire hood is fire resistance, not night sight. The Loom voice needs a Loom totem (see [The sixth voice](sixth_voice)).

pages.title: Telling them apart
text: A bound Spiritweave piece spends **3 Pulse every four seconds** instead of 2, so a bound hood, robe and leggings cost **9**. Boots spend only when they catch you.

You can tell a bound piece at a glance: its trims glow in its voice's colour, Earth green, Fire orange, Water blue, Air pale mint, Spirit violet and Loom cyan, in your hand and when worn. The higher its rank, the brighter it burns.

pages.title: On a pickaxe
text: - **Earth** opens a **3 by 3** of stone with each block; the extra blocks spend Pulse the same way as the first.
- **Fire** smelts what it mines.
- **Water** mines with silk touch.
- **Air** gives haste.
- **Spirit** makes nearby ores glint every few seconds, within 6 blocks (10 at rank 3).
- **Loom** mines for **0 Pulse**, and even starved it usually spares the edge.

pages.title: On the axe and shovel
text: The **axe**, on logs: **Earth** fells the **whole tree**, top down, wherever you strike it; crouch to cut just one log. Only wood with living leaves on it counts as a tree, and wood touching planks, glass, doors, fences or other building blocks is a build, so bare log builds and a cabin grown into a tree stand. Each felled log costs a point of the edge (Unbreaking spares some), and the felling stops before the axe would break, so one felling is only as big as the edge left on the axe: a **Weeping Colossus**, tens of thousands of logs, takes several axes (or mendings). Pulse is paid as the logs come down: every 16 logs cost one swing's Pulse, and a swing's worth that fells nothing (protected wood, say) comes back. **Air** always takes two more, **Water** now and then drops a sapling, **Spirit** makes hostiles within 8 blocks glow, **Fire** chars the wood, and **Loom** sends the logs to your hand.

The **shovel**: **Earth** digs a **3 by 3** of dirt, sand or gravel, **Air** lays paths three wide, **Water** sometimes turns up clay from dirt, **Fire** bakes sand to glass, **Loom** lifts sand and gravel whole, and **Spirit** makes chests, barrels and spawners within 8 blocks glint.

pages.title: On the blade
text: Every paid hit of the blade adds an **echo strike**: a little magic damage, and the foe glows for a few seconds. Its voice adds more:
- **Earth**: knocks the foe back and slows it.
- **Fire**: sets it alight and burns a little deeper.
- **Water**: heals you a heart (two at rank 3).
- **Air**: the blow sweeps into hostiles beside it.
- **Spirit**: a stronger echo strike.
- **Loom**: drags the foe toward you.
The whole [weapon family](spiritgear_weapons) takes voices the same way.

pages.title: On Spiritweave
text: - **Earth**: the hood turns aside one projectile in five (about one in three at rank 3); the robe gives resistance; the leggings push through cobwebs, berry bushes and soul sand; the boots cut knockback and never trample farmland.
- **Fire**: hood and robe give fire resistance, and the robe sets attackers alight for 3 seconds; the leggings give speed in lava and the Nether; the boots ignore hot floors.
- **Water**: the hood gives water breathing; the robe regenerates you when struck (longer at rank 3); the leggings give dolphin's grace; the boots freeze still water underfoot.

pages.title: More Spiritweave voices
text: - **Air**: the hood gives night sight; the robe ignores knockback; the leggings give speed (stronger at rank 3); the boots give slow falling.

- **Spirit**: the hood gives night sight and makes hostiles within 12 blocks glow; the robe gives resistance and makes attackers glow; the leggings give speed and a taller step; the boots cancel fall damage, and at rank 3 bounce you back up from a drop of 4 or more.

- **Loom**: the hood gives luck; the robe sometimes threads the Pulse it spent back into your cell; the leggings push through cobwebs and berry bushes; the boots let you crouch-walk forward to stitch **4 blocks** (**6** at rank 3), then rest 8 seconds.
